name: Tanzania
description: Short-grass plains that empty and refill with the seasons, and a coastline an hour's flight from the last game drive.

name: Botswana
description: A delta that floods when the rest of the region is dry, reached by light aircraft and moved through by boat.

name: Zambia
description: Where the walking safari was invented, and still the country that does it best.

name: Kenya
description: Private conservancies north of Mount Kenya, where the rules are set by the landowners rather than a park authority.

name: Rwanda
description: Terraced hills, bamboo forest at three thousand metres, and eight habituated gorilla families.

name: Namibia
description: The oldest desert on earth meeting the coldest current in the Atlantic, with almost nobody in between.

name: Svalbard
description: Seventy-eight degrees north. Pack ice, bird cliffs and a sun that does not set for four months.

name: Ecuador
description: An archipelago where the wildlife has never learned to be afraid, and the cold months are the good ones.

name: Bhutan
description: Monasteries opened before the doors, valleys crossed on a road that climbs three passes, and a country that limits its own visitors.
